name: Byakuya
source:
---How would you like a tale that can't be told?

Dusk.
Shino Iwazaki made her way to the school rooftop in her priestess gown.
She talked idly with her friend Chizuru Iduki.
Then, two figures clad in black attacked her.

They were as alive as any human, but they were not human.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ126482.html]DLsite English[/url]]
